description:
Create a child inscription - STEP 1: Broadcast commit transaction.

Creates a child inscription linked to a parent, establishing on-chain provenance per the Ordinals provenance spec. You must own the parent inscription.

This broadcasts the commit tx and returns immediately. After it confirms (typically 10-60 min), use `inscribe_child_reveal` to complete.

Returns: commitTxid, revealAddress, revealAmount, parentInscriptionId, feeRate

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

feeRate.description: Fee rate: 'fast' (~10 min), 'medium' (~30 min), 'slow' (~1 hr), or number in sat/vB (default: medium)

parentInscriptionId.description: Parent inscription ID (e.g., 'abc123...i0'). You must own this inscription.

name: inscribe_child
